name: codex-baseline
description: Audit a new or existing repository against shared engineering practices (agents, docs, quality, delivery, security, release) for Codex, and adopt the ones that apply.

interface.shortDescription: Audit a repository against shared practices.
interface.longDescription: Check a new or existing repository against the Agent Toolkit practice catalog, propose the changes worth adopting, and record which practices it adopts or declines.
defaultPrompt: Use Codex Baseline to audit this repository against the shared practices.
